title: The Playful Art Of Critical Thinking
summary: Course Brief Description: This dynamic and interactive course combines playful activities, creativity, and open discussions to explore critical thinking. Participants will learn how to assess information critically, think creatively, and make informed decisions using logic in an engaging, enjoyable, and inspiring environment. Course Objectives: Understanding the importance of critical thinking Developing skills to critically question information and arguments. Fostering open-mindedness and intellectual humility.
